verdict.rationale: Morph is API-first. Its published OpenAPI 3.1 document covers inference, Fast Apply, Compact, model listing, and account-level operations such as dedicated endpoint management, credits and budgets. Custom Reflex training also runs fully through API jobs, so much of the dashboard surface appears to be programmable. Nothing states explicit UI-to-API parity, and gaps remain for UI functions such as API-key, team and billing management. Missing for 10: an explicit parity commitment, API coverage of key/team/billing administration, and independent corroboration that every dashboard action has an API equivalent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
